name: Video Generate
description: Generate short-form (Shorts/Reels/TikTok) videos from slides via the dashboard ffmpeg+TTS pipeline. engine=higgsfield는 Higgsfield MCP로 생성한 클립을 후처리(자막/효과음)하는 경로.

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard base URL the gateway calls for ffmpeg rendering. network_mode=host에선 http://127.0.0.1:{DASHBOARD_PORT}. 미설정 시 VIDEO_DASHBOARD_URL env 또는 http://127.0.0.1:34560(기본).
